actions.reason: The K5_C0001-K5_C0005 boundary is essentially not represented in candidate-consensus geometry: near-zero agreement with an independent two-way spectral partition (ARI 0.044), high normalized-cut cost (0.904) with elevated between-side affinity (0.230), and a union eigengap strongly dominated by the single-cluster resolution (candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.733), which is merge-compatible. Native-view evidence is weak and conflicting, with only WSI showing moderate separation (silhouette 0.393) while CT, RNA, and WXS are near zero (0.029, 0.040, 0.023) with substantial negative fractions. The weak current boundary together with a single-cluster-dominated union is a coherent merge-compatible pattern, so the two sets are provisionally revised to K5_C0001∪K5_C0005.

actions.reason: K5_C0001_M_K5_C0005 has a substantive, interpretable biological identity: a coherent ccRCC chromatin-remodeling mutation profile with strong PBRM1 enrichment (OR 15.66, q_global=1.18e-05) and VHL enrichment with BAP1 depletion, plus a coherent metabolically/immunologically down-shifted transcriptomic program (oxidative phosphorylation and immune pathways down at FDR q=0.001). Membership representation is weak (CT silhouette -0.070 with negative fraction 0.974; RNA 0.021; WSI 0.064; WXS 0.092), but the relevant neighboring boundaries are not merge-compatible: against K5_C0003 the structural diagnostics show ARI 0.792 with within-side affinity 0.399 exceeding between-side 0.111 and a union eigengap candidate_k=2 aligned with the current two-way structure, and against K5_C0004 ARI 1.0 with within 0.398 exceeding between 0.108. The K5_C0002 boundary is the only conflicting one (union candidate_k=1), and no measured technical factor is significantly associated with membership after FDR (tissue source site and CT manufacturer only nominal). No supported split or merge remains, so the candidate is retained as an independent discovery-stage unit.

K5_C0002 has a substantive, interpretable biological identity: a coherent oxidative-phosphorylation/secretory/metabolic transcriptomic program (OXPHOS, protein secretion, fatty-acid metabolism, adipogenesis, mTORC1 all at FDR q=0.001, NES 2.0-2.85) and a coherent ccRCC mutation profile with strong VHL depletion (OR 0.032, q_global=3.07e-07) and driver-panel PBRM1 depletion. Membership representation is weak and largely negative (CT 0.022; RNA -0.082; WSI -0.064; WXS -0.083), and multiple measured acquisition factors are significantly associated with membership after FDR (tissue source site V=0.418, CT manufacturer 0.320, reconstruction kernel 0.346, scanner model 0.338, slice thickness 0.170, z-spacing 0.181), which is a plausible candidate-specific alternative explanation. However, the relevant neighboring boundary to K5_C0003 is well represented (ARI 0.920, within-side affinity 0.450 exceeding between-side 0.151), and the K5_C0001_M_K5_C0005 boundary shows ARI 0.690 with within 0.384 exceeding between 0.138. No supported split or merge remains, so the candidate is retained as an independent discovery-stage unit.

K5_C0003 has a substantive, interpretable biological identity: a coherent immune/inflammatory transcriptomic program (allograft rejection, interferon alpha/gamma, IL6/JAK/STAT3, inflammatory response at FDR q=0.001) and a coherent BAP1-associated ccRCC mutation profile (BAP1 OR 23.06, q_global=0.018, the only driver-panel gene surviving global FDR). Membership representation is mixed and weak (RNA 0.144 with zero negative fraction; CT 0.042; WSI -0.070; WXS -0.086), and tissue source site (V=0.414), slice thickness, and z-spacing are significantly associated with membership after FDR, a plausible candidate-specific alternative explanation. However, the relevant neighboring boundaries are represented: against K5_C0004 ARI 0.871 with within-side affinity 0.629 exceeding between-side 0.131 and a union eigengap candidate_k=2 aligned with the two-way structure; against K5_C0002 ARI 0.920 with within 0.450 exceeding between 0.151; against K5_C0001_M_K5_C0005 ARI 0.792 with within 0.399 exceeding between 0.111 and union candidate_k=2 aligned. No supported split or merge remains, so the candidate is retained as an independent discovery-stage unit.

K5_C0004 has a substantive, interpretable biological identity: a coherent mesenchymal/stromal transcriptomic program (EMT NES 2.34 at FDR q=0.001, UV-response-DN, Hedgehog, angiogenesis, mitotic spindle, with OXPHOS and ROS down) and a coherent VHL-enriched ccRCC mutation profile (VHL OR 32.41, q_driver=0.0013, all 14 patients mutated; PBRM1 depletion OR 0.044). Membership representation is conflicting (CT -0.052, RNA -0.053, WSI -0.066 all negative with high negative fractions; WXS silhouette 1.0, an extreme boundary value at n=14), and no measured technical factor is significantly associated with membership after FDR. The relevant neighboring boundary to K5_C0003 is well represented (ARI 0.871, within-side affinity 0.629 exceeding between-side 0.131, union eigengap candidate_k=2 aligned with the two-way structure), and the K5_C0001_M_K5_C0005 boundary shows ARI 1.0 with within 0.398 exceeding between 0.108. No supported split or merge remains, so the candidate is retained as an independent discovery-stage unit.
